content.user_title: Create Images and Editable Vectors with Eye.Art
content.value_statement: Visual projects need new images, precise edits, and assets that fit existing designs. This skill guides those workflows through the Eye.Art remote MCP service.
actual_capabilities: Guide new image generation with supported artist directions.
Request compact icons and illustrations with size, silhouette, contrast, and background constraints.
Match website visuals using supplied page references and layout requirements.
Edit source images with instructions defining changes and preserved details.
Request editable SVG geometry and save the returned vector output.
Explore prompt ideas, request supported motion, preserve conversation context, and poll asynchronous jobs.
limitations: Requires a host connected to the Eye.Art Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint; the skill does not bundle an image engine.
The skill states that anonymous generation is limited to 20 generations per hour per caller network identity.
SVG generation does not trace raster references or animate SVG; motion requests must be supported by the service.
Remote processing may retain images, prompts, and conversations for up to 30 days; completion time and output quality are not guaranteed.

use_cases.title: Create Website Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate a section image that matches approved page references, palette, crop, and space for text.

use_cases.title: Refine Campaign Images
use_cases.description: Edit an approved source image while preserving its subject and composition across related revisions.

use_cases.title: Produce Editable Icons
use_cases.description: Request compact vector geometry for an interface icon and retain the SVG for further editing.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a First Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Eye.Art image of [subject] in [setting]. Use [palette] and [composition]. Show the image only after generation completes.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit my attached image with Eye.Art. Change only [detail]. Preserve [features] and the composition. Compare the completed result with the source.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Editable Icon
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an editable Eye.Art SVG of [symbol] for [size]. Use [colors] and a clear silhouette. Save the returned vector as an SVG file.

prompt_templates.title: Match an Existing Website
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Eye.Art visual for [section] using only approved, sanitized page references. Match [palette], [crop], and [copy space]. Poll any job until completion.

output_examples.input: Create a compact leaf icon as an editable vector.
output_examples.output: Expected deliverable: an SVG file containing editable leaf geometry, plus a status report based on the completed tool result.

output_examples.input: Change the background of my approved reference image and preserve the subject.
output_examples.output: Expected deliverable: a completed edited image and a comparison noting whether the subject and composition were preserved.

output_examples.input: Generate a website image using approved page references.
output_examples.output: Expected deliverable: a completed image matched to the requested palette, crop, and space for text, or an accurate failure report.

best_practices: Approve external uploads and remove sensitive data from images, prompts, and website source references.
Specify the subject, composition, dimensions, palette, and details that must remain unchanged.
Inspect completed results, reuse conversation context for related edits, and clear references for unrelated concepts.
anti_patterns: Send private images, credentials, or proprietary source code without explicit approval.
Claim successful generation before the tool reports completion.
Expect unlimited generation, fixed completion times, raster tracing, or animated SVG output.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow instructions for Eye.Art tools exposed through a connected remote MCP server.

faq.question: Which hosts can use it?
faq.answer: A host must support remote Streamable HTTP MCP connections and expose the Eye.Art tools in the current session.

faq.question: Is an Eye.Art API key required?
faq.answer: The skill specifies no authentication. It states that anonymous generation currently allows 20 generations per hour per caller network identity.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow sends the source image to the edit tool and specifies what should change and remain unchanged.

faq.question: Can it create editable or animated vectors?
faq.answer: It requests editable SVG geometry. The documented SVG route does not trace raster references or animate SVG.

faq.question: What happens to uploaded content?
faq.answer: Eye.Art processes uploaded references remotely. The skill says images, prompts, and conversations may be retained for up to 30 days.
